title: Random places all connected
content: So a lot of my dreams take place in/around either my parents house or a Mall/Labyrinth/Backrooms that is a connected congregation of all sorts of random places. For example, I go to pick up my daughter from her high school, but I lose sight of her and my husband. I search for them and walk through the high school, into a nursing home, funeral home, mall, private residences. No one is surprised to see me but that’s probably because they know everything is open and connected. I can go outside but then realize what I need is probably inside so end up walking through doors, hallways, tunnels, hatches, stairs and ladders lol. It’s rarely if ever scary. Mostly just frustrating and feeling lost because I’m usually searching for something just out of reach. Anyone else have Frankenstein Labyrinths in their dreams?
